name: Akazome Emon
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 59); Porter gives no dates for this poet.

poems.title: Waiting and hoping for thy step
poems.author: Akazome Emon
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 59
poems.text:
Waiting and hoping for thy step,
Sleepless in bed I lie,
All through the night, until the moon,
Leaving her post on high,
Slips sideways down the sky.
